bible.logline: In Sengoku-era Japan, a fox demon sister and her human brother travel the country fighting rogue spirits and evil bandits alongside a cowardly ronin.
bible.genre: Historical, Action, Fantasy, Supernatural, Comedy, Adventure
bible.world: Set in Sengoku-period Japan where humans live alongside monsters and spirits known as Katawara. Some humans possess spiritual techniques and magic talismans to fight or transform, while spirits wield elemental powers. The land is filled with roving bandits, corrupt warriors, and wandering Katawara, creating a turbulent world of clash between human and spirit realms.

bible.arc: In Chapter 1, Youko Tama and her adopted human brother Jinka travel across Sengoku-era Japan aiming to stop evil deeds and reform wicked humans and spirits. On a dirt road, they encounter a gang of bandits demanding their belongings. Jinka uses an earth-fist talisman magic to swiftly send the bandits flying into the sky, knocking them unconscious. Disappointed that they knocked out the bandits before questioning them about their hideout, Tama and Jinka resume their trek. While resting and eating rice balls by a river, Tama senses someone tailing them and forces out a nervous traveling ronin named Hyoudou Shinsuke, who admits he was fascinated by Jinka's mysterious technique.

manga.title: Sengoku Youko
manga.description: "Stop your evil deeds and take the right path!" That is the creed of Youko Tama and her younger step brother, Jinka Sendou. The two demon siblings travel the country to stop the deeds of all evil doers, along with a scaredy-cat swordsman they picked up along the way, Hyoudou Shinsuke. During their travels, they will come across a monk organization with more than suspicious methods and they'll soon be at war.

week_outline.episode_summary: In Sengoku-era Japan, fox demon Tama and her human brother Jinka travel the country reforming wicked humans and spirits. After routing a bandit gang and rescuing the cowardly ronin Shinsuke, they discover a dark threat looming as powerful exorcists begin hunting rogue Katawara.

parts.beat: On a dusty Sengoku road, Jinka Sendou and Youko Tama are ambushed by mocking bandits. Jinka casually drops talisman papers, summoning massive spectral earth fists that launch the bandits high into the clouds. While resting at a riverbank, Tama senses an intruder hiding in the bushes and drags out Hyoudou Shinsuke, a terrified traveling ronin fascinated by Jinka's spirit technique.
parts.set_piece: Massive spectral fists erupting from glowing paper talismans and launching bandits flying into the sky.
parts.hook: Shinsuke nervously exposes himself and begs to know the secret behind Jinka's magic.

parts.beat: Jinka explains his spirit golem art, terrifying Shinsuke with a giant snake apparition. Shinsuke offers to guide the duo to the infamous Oni Helmet Gang hideout in exchange for traveling together. Reaching the forest camp, Tama boldly steps forward and delivers an impassioned utopian speech urging the ruthless bandits to drop their weapons and embrace peace and love.
parts.set_piece: Jinka conjuring a towering, ghostly spirit snake that looms terrifyingly over the trembling Shinsuke.
parts.hook: The bandits mock Tama's speech and draw their swords to attack the group.

parts.beat: As the bandits charge, a panicking Shinsuke rushes forward and accidentally slices the bandit leader's helmet in half. The broken helmet reveals a grotesque, multi-limbed demon underneath, petrifying the gang. Recognizing the monster, Tama touches Jinka's hand to initiate their spirit-fusion ritual, unleashing a surging aura of fox power.
parts.set_piece: The spirit-fusion transformation where Jinka's hair explodes into wild white-orange fox fur amid burning spiritual energy.
parts.hook: Jinka stands fully transformed into a fierce fox demon hybrid, ready to crush the multi-limbed beast.

parts.beat: Transformed Jinka politely apologizes to the demon boss before unleashing the devastating 'Rod of the Five Buddha' technique, pulverizing the monster into dust. The remaining bandits flee in terror while Jinka reverts to human form. Tama and Jinka strike their heroic pose as world-reformers, leaving Shinsuke utterly bewildered.
parts.set_piece: Jinka's staff slamming down with celestial light, completely vaporizing the demon boss into dust.
parts.hook: On a distant highway, a strange rock monster named Shakugan appears in agonizing tears.

parts.beat: Monk Sairen of the Dangaishuu order attempts to subdue the rampaging rock creature Shakugan, but his sacred barrier fails instantly. The monster violently strikes down the monk and collapses on the dirt road, desperately weeping and calling out for Koshiro. A fleeing merchant escapes into the night as the creature stumbles away in agony.
parts.set_piece: Shakugan the massive jagged rock monster shattering Monk Sairen's glowing barrier with raw brute force.
parts.hook: Shakugan collapses crying out a mysterious name before crawling into the dark forest.

parts.beat: Shinsuke trails Jinka and Tama into a bustling village inn to rest for the night. Inside, a panicked traveler shows a sketch of Shakugan to a group of Dangaishuu exorcist monks, confirming Monk Sairen's death. Enraged by the news, the head Dangaishuu monk smashes his arm through the wooden floor, swearing absolute annihilation on all demons.
parts.set_piece: The Dangaishuu monk shattering the tavern floorboards with a single surge of rage and spiritual force.
parts.hook: Shinsuke realizes the ruthless Dangaishuu monks are hunting demons right in their path.

parts.beat: In their room, Tama explains the dangerous nature of the Dangaishuu exorcists. Shinsuke steps outside into the cool night air and dramatically vows to forge a sword capable of slaying demons, only to get kicked by Tama for his dramatic antics. As dawn breaks, the trio sets off together across the rolling grassy fields toward their next adventure.
parts.set_piece: Shinsuke making his impassioned oath under a massive silver moon before Tama humorously kicks him down.
parts.hook: The shadow of the vengeful Dangaishuu monks follows close behind as the trio marches onward.

shorts.summary: Jinka and Tama confront arrogant bandits on a dusty road, effortlessly dispatching them with massive spectral earth fists before meeting a timid ronin named Shinsuke at a riverbank.

episodes.title: سلّم التهام الآلهة: عهد من قاع الهاوية
episodes.summary: Betrayed by squad commander Liora Valkross at the edge of the forbidden Abyssal Sinks, the Crestless scout Kael is cast into the bottomless depths as sacrificial bait. Plummeting into the entombed Singularity Vault, he confronts the primordial entity Malakor and accepts a soul-binding pact of Null-Ascension to survive. As the Primordial Singularity fuses into Kael's shattered chest, his right arm is consumed by searing obsidian scars of Tier Zero. Above the abyss, Liora watches the rift violently seal as ancient horrors awaken around Kael in the subterranean dark. Trapped as the Abyssal Sinks seal shut, Kael unleashes the forbidden Tier Zero power of the Primordial Singularity to obliterate an attacking horde of shadow beasts. However, the uncapped progression system immediately demands its first cruel tax, permanently stripping away Kael's physical sense of warmth just as an ancient crystal titan awakens. Kael unleashes the forbidden Tier Zero void blade to destroy the Abyssal Titan, but pays the permanent tax of losing his physical warmth. As Liora seals the chasm from above assuming he is dead, Malakor reveals the terrifying truth that the world's worshipped sun is a parasite god.

episodes.title: ثرى الفراغ المحترق: من يخلف إرادة الآلهة الملعونة؟
episodes.summary: Kael fights the Guardian Colossus in the depths of the Abyssal Sinks to unlock Tier One of Null-Ascension. Slaying the divine construct with new phantom blade arts, Kael achieves ascension but permanently pays the painful mortal tax of his sense of taste and physical warmth. Having unlocked Tier One of Null-Ascension at the cost of his physical warmth and sense of taste, Kael tests his new spatial Phantom Blade Arts in the subterranean abyssal ruins. High above, Liora senses a terrifying shift in the Solar Crest network, while Kael encounters the blind wanderer Varek who warns him of an incoming execution squad. Guided by the blind wanderer Varek, Kael is ambushed in the flooded crystal ruins by a Solar Hierarch execution squad sent to erase Crestless witnesses. Kael unleashes his newly mastered Tier One Phantom Blade Arts to slice through the zealots, but the squad captain triggers a high-altitude Solar Beacon before dying, pinpointing Kael's Void signature directly to Commander Liora above. After activating the Solar Beacon upon his defeat, the executioner alerts Commander Liora Valkross that Kael has survived and transformed into a forbidden Void harbinger. As Liora orders an orbital strike on the entire crystal stratum, Kael reaches an exiled alchemist's refuge where a terrifying prophecy of world destruction is revealed.

episodes.title: ثمن الصعود: عندما تبتلع الظلال الذاكرة
episodes.summary: Escaping an orbital strike from the upper bastions, Kael navigates the flooded crystal layer and rescues the exiled alchemist Sari Hazel from Solar automata. Upon analyzing Kael's Void aura, Sari horrifyingly recognizes his Null-Ascension signature as the apocalyptic harbinger destined to shatter their subterranean world. As the flooded crystal layer begins to violently decay under Kael's Void energy, Sari warns him that his Null-Ascension signature is accelerating Ostra-Terra's destruction. With Commander Liora initiating a thermal purge to melt the entire stratum, Kael is forced to destabilize an ancient Titan spire, triggering a catastrophic Tier Two awakening. Trapped under Commander Liora's thermal purge, Kael is forced to drive his Void arm into the core of the ancient Titan Spire to survive. By unlocking Tier Two Null-Ascension at the cost of his childhood memories, Kael triggers a catastrophic spatial phase-dash just as the subterranean layer collapses. Escaping the collapsing stratum through spatial phase-dashing, Kael pays the brutal Tier Two tax by losing all memories of his childhood home. As the artificial sun bleeds pitch-black void corruption across Ostra-Terra, Kael descends into the lower civilian slums to face Liora's coming purge.
